Alex (CSM): Priya — quick kickoff: can we confirm stakeholders and top success criteria so we can lock the 14d plan? I propose: weekly ops sync, integration test by D7, go-live pilot by D14. Thoughts?
Priya (BrightSky): Thanks Alex. Stakeholders: me (Priya), Raj (Eng), Sofia (Security). Success criteria: 1) API stable w/ <200ms 95p, 2) sample user flows passing smoke tests, 3) SSO + data retention policy agreed. D7 integration test looks ok.
Jordan (Solutions Eng): I'll own integration test. Need access: api key + staging endpoint. @Priya can you confirm Raj will provision staging network? Also, quick note: we should pin model version to avoid drift during pilot.
Priya (BrightSky): Yes Raj will do it. Raj out till Thu but available Mon for provisioning. Model pin sounds good. Do you recommend a specific quantized variant?
Jordan (Solutions Eng): We'll start with `redwood/azure-opt-3b-q4` (perf tradeoff). If latency > target we'll switch to `redwood/opt-2.5b`. I'll add to runbook.
Devon (Enablement): I'll schedule a 45m enablement session (D5) for your devs and support team. Will use this checklist:
```
- Intro to API (keys, rate limits)
- Integration test script
- Error handling patterns
- Observability: where to see latency/cost
- Rollback & fallback patterns
```
OnboardBot: Reminder: kickoff doc created: https://redwood.internal/onboards/BS-102 — created by Alex
Alex (CSM): Great. Action items: Priya to confirm Raj availability (D1), Jordan to prepare integration checklist (D3), Devon to send invite (D2). I'll run weekly ops sync starting Mon. @Priya any concerns about renewal timeline we should flag?
Priya (BrightSky): Renewal at month 11. Would love to track health metrics weekly; can we add a dashboard export to our weekly report? Also minor ask: can support SLA be 4h during pilot?
Alex (CSM): Yes we can include a weekly health export table. I'll confirm SLA with CS Ops. For now we'll treat pilot as priority.
Raj (Eng): Confirming I'll provision staging Monday morning and will add Priya to the staging access group.
Alex (CSM): Thanks all. I'll update kickoff doc with owners and next steps.
